column1: # Hand-checked expected results for fixture-data.sql (worked out by hand; see ../README.md).
# One case per "##" line: ## <case name> | <metric name> | <group-by focus level> | <filters>
#   filters: "Level=value" joined by " & "; value \N means IS NULL; "-" means no filter.
#   A filter value is the level's KEY (SQL/018: Sprint = sprint_num, Month = sprint_month, Year & Month = year_month,
#   ...); for a level without a key column (Year, Team, Level N) it is the label.
# Then the expected rows in order, "label|value"; an empty value means NULL (no bar); \N label = NULL label.
# A case with no rows expects an empty result.
## ratio of sums across sprints | Say/Do Ratio | Team | -
## NULL label groups separately | Say/Do Ratio | Level 2 | -
## zero denominator = NULL, not an error | Say/Do Ratio | Sprint | Team=Team A
## Month (all years) merges January 2025 and 2026; month-name labels in month order | Say/Do Ratio | Month | -
## Year & Month keeps them apart; tie 75.00; "Mon YYYY" labels in key order | Say/Do Ratio | Year & Month | -
## average ignores NULLs; 21.125 rounds up; tie 15.50 | Velocity | Team | -
## group whose only value is NULL | Velocity | Team | Sprint=2 & Team=Team A
## GREATEST per row, then ratio of sums | Scope Churn | Team | -
## team with no facts = empty result | Say/Do Ratio | Team | Team=Team E
## filter IS NULL | Say/Do Ratio | Team | Level 2=\N
## apostrophe in a filter value | Say/Do Ratio | Team | Level 2=Mgr O'Brien
## Quarter labels Q1..Q4 in quarter order (all years) | Say/Do Ratio | Quarter | -
## Year & Sprint: label "<sprint> <year>" (SQL/019), key = start date, so years stay apart | Say/Do Ratio | Year & Sprint | Team=Team A
## filter by a key: Month = 1 means January of every year | Say/Do Ratio | Year & Month | Month=1
